req.title: Rate limit not enforced
req.statement: The system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-039 states the system shall NOT throttle single-client request rates below 60/min. This means 60 sequential requests within one minute must all return HTTP 2xx. Tests cover: (1) positive – exactly 60 requests all succeed (EP, catches constant mutation 60->59 or 61); (2) boundary – 59 requests (one below threshold, all must succeed, BVA ±1); (3) boundary – 61 requests (one above threshold, all must still succeed, BVA ±1); (4) negative – verifying that a single malformed request returns 4xx not 2xx (NEG, confirms error pathway). All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with SQLite in-memory override to avoid filesystem side-effects and ensure determinism.

tests.name: test_rate_limit_60_requests_all_succeed
preconditions: No rate limiting middleware is active below 60 req/min
actions: Send exactly 60 GET /tasks/ requests sequentially using TestClient
expected: No response returns HTTP 429 or any 4xx/5xx
trace: R-TASK-039: system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine_mem = create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionMem = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionMem()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

REQUEST_COUNT = 60
statuses = [client.get('/tasks/').status_code for _ in range(REQUEST_COUNT)]

assert len(statuses) == 60
assert all(s == 200 for s in statuses), f'Non-200 responses found: {[s for s in statuses if s != 200]}'
assert statuses.count(200) == 60

app.dependency_overrides.clear()

tests.name: test_malformed_request_returns_4xx_not_throttled
preconditions: Client sends a POST /tasks/ with invalid payload (empty title violating min_length=1)
actions: Send POST /tasks/ with title='' (empty string, violates min_length=1)
Assert response is 4xx (client error), not 2xx or 429
trace: R-TASK-039: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error; empty title must be rejected with 422

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine_mem4 = create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionMem4 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem4)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem4)

def override_get_db4():
    db = SessionMem4()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db4
client4 = TestClient(app)

bad_payload = {'title': '', 'description': 'some desc', 'completed': False}
resp = client4.post('/tasks/', json=bad_payload)

assert resp.status_code == 422
assert resp.status_code != 200
assert resp.status_code != 201
assert resp.status_code != 429
body = resp.json()
assert 'detail' in body

app.dependency_overrides.clear()

tests.name: test_rate_limit_mixed_endpoints_60_requests_all_succeed
preconditions: Database seeded with at least one task (POST creates it)
actions: Send 59 GET /tasks/ requests to reach total of 60 requests
expected: Total 60 requests all return 2xx with no throttling
trace: R-TASK-039: decision table — mixed request types still count toward 60/min; all must succeed
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine_mem5 = create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionMem5 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem5)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem5)

def override_get_db5():
    db = SessionMem5()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db5
client5 = TestClient(app)

post_resp = client5.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Buy groceries', 'description': 'A', 'completed': True})
assert post_resp.status_code == 201

get_statuses = [client5.get('/tasks/').status_code for _ in range(59)]
assert len(get_statuses) == 59
assert all(s == 200 for s in get_statuses), f'Non-200: {[s for s in get_statuses if s != 200]}'
assert get_statuses.count(200) == 59

all_statuses = [post_resp.status_code] + get_statuses
assert len(all_statuses) == 60
assert all(200 <= s <= 299 for s in all_statuses)

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
